title: Malaysia Offshore Exploration Drilling
thesis: Snowflake turns daily rig data from a fictional offshore exploration operator into productive-time, NPT, mud-quality and diesel-intensity KPIs, 7-day NPT-risk scores, standpipe pressure anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Productive time, NPT events, mud checks within spec and diesel intensity for 30 rigs and units working from 4 Malaysian supply bases.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to rig-day rows. Thresholds are internal demo thresholds.
The root-cause chart shows which NPT causes cost the most rig hours.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of drilling KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which rigs are likely to lose time next?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each rig's probability of an NPT event in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags standpipe pressure outliers per rig, and the forecast projects fleet-wide diesel use for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How healthy are the checks behind those risks?

talking_points: Rigs monitored and current-well depth progress frame the campaign.
BOP pressure-test completion against mud checks within spec by rig shows where test discipline and fluid quality move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, NPT, cause and risk tables only.
show: BOP test completion vs mud in spec
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a rig-floor sensor alarms right now?

talking_points: Live standpipe pressure and hookload readings land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the rig's current risk band, then emails the drilling superintendent.
tabs.call_out: From alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic NPT-response SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
